blocks.title: Business pitch
blocks.text: Business pitch karobari khayal samjhane wali mukhtasar presentation hai: khayal kya hai, gahak kaun hain aur yeh kyun chalega.

Juice ki dukaan ke liye: khayal taza, sehatmand, sasta juice; gahak mohalle ke sehat ka khayal rakhne wale log; yeh chalega kyunke qareeb koi juice ki dukaan nahi aur log sehat par zyada dhyan de rahe hain. Kitab batati hai ke Apple aur Google jaisi companies ne himayat aur sarmaya pane ke liye saade pitches se shuruaat ki (Did You Know).
